requirements.title: Table 18.5 error code values indicate the described error conditions
requirements.source: S18.5.4 p12 and Table 18.5 error conditions; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF535.
requirements.definition: The Table 18.5 macro values indicate the named conditions: success, null or nonnull base address errors, invalid element length, rank, type, attribute, extent, or descriptor, memory allocation failure, and out-of-bounds reference.

pending.cfi-success-means-no-error: After 18.5.5 registration, call CFI_establish with valid CFI_CDESC_T(1) storage, a three-element int array, elem_len sizeof(int), rank one, valid extent three, CFI_attribute_other, and CFI_type_int under availability guards; assert the result is CFI_SUCCESS, with mutation changing rank to two.
pending.error-base-addr-null-condition: Call a descriptor function context requiring nonnull base_addr with a descriptor whose base_addr is NULL and assert the named result CFI_ERROR_BASE_ADDR_NULL; mutation supplies a nonnull three-element array.
pending.error-base-addr-not-null-condition: Call a descriptor function context requiring null base_addr with a descriptor whose base_addr points at a sentinel object and assert CFI_ERROR_BASE_ADDR_NOT_NULL; mutation supplies NULL.
pending.invalid-elem-len-condition: Call CFI_establish or another registered function with elem_len zero for a scalar int descriptor requiring positive storage and assert CFI_INVALID_ELEM_LEN; mutation uses sizeof(int).
pending.invalid-rank-condition: Call a registered descriptor function with rank CFI_MAX_RANK+1 in a generated source-control path and assert CFI_INVALID_RANK rather than any numeric value; mutation uses rank one.
pending.invalid-type-condition: Call a registered descriptor function with a type code not accepted for the operation, using CFI_type_other as the invalid value and asserting CFI_INVALID_TYPE; mutation uses CFI_type_int under availability guards.
pending.invalid-attribute-condition: Call a registered descriptor function with an attribute code not among the three standard attribute macros, using a generated value distinct from them, and assert CFI_INVALID_ATTRIBUTE; mutation uses CFI_attribute_other.
pending.invalid-extent-condition: Call a registered descriptor function with a negative non-assumed-size extent in a nonfinal dimension and assert CFI_INVALID_EXTENT; mutation uses extent three.
pending.invalid-descriptor-condition: No single portable corruption pattern is guaranteed to be diagnosed as the generic invalid descriptor rather than a more specific Table 18.5 condition; future fixtures prefer the specific named errors and leave this facet pending absent a standard function context that isolates it.
pending.error-mem-allocation-condition: No portable oracle can force memory allocation failure without relying on resource exhaustion or processor limits; future fixtures do not attempt to require CFI_ERROR_MEM_ALLOCATION.
pending.error-out-of-bounds-condition: After CFI_address or CFI_section behavior is registered, establish a rank-one descriptor with extent three and request subscript four; assert CFI_ERROR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS or a null result exactly as the function text specifies, with mutation requesting subscript two.
